ct-rank-two-limit: tex 1796-1798, "Its finitely generated restriction image lies in a finite product of groups GL_2(k[z,z^-1]), hence in a Haagerup group by [GHW, Theorem 4], and is finite." Closed endpoint (#audit_closed_axioms, no kernel hypothesis): the image of a Kazhdan subgroup of GL_2(R_X) under core restriction is finite. Printed route: the coefficients of finitely many generators refine a finite clopen partition, evaluation at one point per atom (evalLaurent) separates the image into finitely many GL_2(k[z,z^-1]) inside GL_2(k(z)), GHW Theorem 4 gives Haagerup, and Delorme gives finiteness. LANDED 8509c9a55, 86e64d0a3, a34f74c76, 11c23415f.

ct-rank-two-limit: tex 1799-1800, "The remaining kernel is locally finite, so a finite-index subgroup of the Kazhdan group is finitely generated and locally finite, hence finite." LANDED 70317e581, 3bbabdc89.
